answer: Operator forfeiture ledger ties every identity to its operator account, charging a non-transferable 0.02 ETH fee per identity to that account, not the wallet, so sybils cannot wander across fresh wallets. One proven fake forfeits all fees in the operator’s cluster and cuts its issuance quota, denying a fresh haven. The operator then waits 180 days before another voyage and earns nothing during review.
